name: DeckLens (Pitch Deck Analyzer)
description: Starts with a ten-question interview to establish what you care about in a deck, records that as a profile you can edit later, then scores decks against a fixed framework. Best suited to someone reviewing enough decks to want consistent criteria rather than a one-off opinion.

official.title: DeckLens by Brian
official.description: A pitch-deck analyst that builds an explicit, editable review profile from a ten-question interview, then evaluates decks against a standard framework...
